package_contents: Only isolated custom tools, their images, and print guide/settings/costs; no scans, home photos or machine commands.

engineering_review.challenge: Thinner panel is less stiff. Is weight reduction hiding a support requirement?
engineering_review.resolution: 8 mm is a supported-tool design choice, not minimum engineered thickness. Broad independent padded bracing remains required; no rod-nut clamping, pressure casting or tamping. Physical seating/deflection and release rehearsal required.

engineering_review.challenge: Moving the front tabs from Z9.05..12.05 to Z5.05..8.05 can change clearance.
engineering_review.resolution: Recomputed actual captured seated slice and conditional nut-removed forward sweep: zero added-tab overlap. Unknown rod sections/scan errors remain unverified; no guarantee of physical clearance.

engineering_review.challenge: Does the lighter revision change the molding contour or deeper rear reliefs?
engineering_review.resolution: STEP boolean symmetric difference of RF02/RF03 rear geometry below Z0.05 is below 0.01 mm3. Same collar surfaces and reliefs.

engineering_review.challenge: A nice printer may have a small bed.
engineering_review.resolution: Explicit 250x250 usable area including brim; 240 mm actual diameter. Do not scale. Small bed requires separately designed split tool, not an automatic slicer cut.

engineering_review.challenge: Will thin tabs or collar require supports?
engineering_review.resolution: Tabs start on the bed and end at 3 mm. Collar grows from the face, tapering by 1 degree. Delivered mesh layer-support test passes; friend must still inspect actual slicer preview.

engineering_review.challenge: Does print authorization imply repair/waterproofing approval?
engineering_review.resolution: No: authorized temporary print and dry fit only. All form/film/pads removed; physical repair suitability, support, engagement and water sealing remain separate.
